mentions.name: Time at the Tone
mentions.description: A web-based speaking clock that announces the time at the tone. It provides an accurate spoken time reference so users can synchronize clocks around them, such as microwave and oven clocks, that are visually out of sync.
mentions.problem: Many clocks around the author, especially microwave and oven clocks, were visually out of sync.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a web-based speaking clock: https://alexsci.com/time-at-the-tone/

I had been doing lots of time-based work for a blog post and ended up annoyed that so many clocks around me were visually out of sync. Especially my microwave and oven clocks. Using the tool I got them synced up beyond what I could perceive.
